resources.string: Intelligent Plant Disease Detection System for offline potato and tomato leaf checks. AI estimates can be wrong; verify before treatment.
A photo check screens for a clear leaf before two on-device models identify the plant and classify its condition.
Predictions are estimates. Lighting, leaf condition, and photo quality can affect results. Use the suggested care as guidance and confirm important decisions with a plant-health professional.
